name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: A file on a card: its glyph in a tile frame, its name, its size or status in mono, and row actions.
usage: Use for files a person attaches (a sitemap to crawl, a CSV of URLs for a batch, a brand kit) or files a job produced. Set state idle (waiting, dashed), uploading or processing (name dimmed, add a Spinner), error (soft red and a red line) or done. AttachmentTrigger makes the whole card open the file; AttachmentGroup scrolls a row of them.
avoid: A progress bar inside the card
A card that grows on hover
